❑ In summary :
❖ We discussed algorithms that can efficiently determine pixels that 
define a line, a circle, a parabola, an ellipse, a hyperbola, and other 
shorts of curves. 
❖However, we have yet not discussed how to fill/colour regions 
bounded by geometrical primitives. 
❖ This lecture talks about – how to fill a region with a specified colour.

Region Filling Algorithms
❖ Given
▪ Colour of the boundary pixels are known
❖ Algorithm: 
▪Picks a point (pixel) inside the polygon (called seed point)
▪Start filling with a specified colour until it hits the boundary of the 
polygon.
▪ The algorithm progresses (implemented) based on 4-connectivity or 8-
connectivity
▪ Algorithm stops when it hits a boundary color

❖ Algorithm– 
▪In this algorithm, we assign a new specified colour to all the pixels of a 
region.
▪ The algorithm is almost similar to the seed algorithm, with the difference 
that the decision is taken based on interior pixel of the current pixel instead 
of the boundary pixel colour.
▪ Like seed algorithm, this algorithm also progresses (implemented) based 
on 4-connectivity or 8-connectivity
Region Filling Algorithms
2. Flood Filling Algorithm 
❖ Generally, it is used to re-colour a region i.e., initially the colour of the interior 
pixels of a region is known.

❖ Summary-
▪Both the algorithms used for colouring a given region with a specified 
colour.
▪Flood fill is one in which all connected pixels of a selected colour get 
replaced by a fill specified colour.
▪ Seed fill algorithm (boundary-fill algorithm) stops when it founds a 
specified boundary colour.
